name: ui-click
prompt: Short crisp UI button click, a soft plastic tap with a gentle high tick, no reverb tail

name: vehicle-select
prompt: A small friendly transit vehicle horn giving one short soft beep, close and dry

name: dispatch-depart
prompt: Electric bus doors hiss shut and the vehicle pulls away from the curb with a rising motor whir

name: passengers-board
prompt: A small group of passengers stepping up into a bus, light footsteps on metal steps and a soft boarding chime

name: queue-full-depart
prompt: A full tram departing its stop, rising electric motor whine with a single bright bell ding at the start

name: mismatch-sigh
prompt: A waiting passenger gives a short disappointed sigh and shuffles back in line, fabric rustle

name: wrong-vehicle
prompt: A bus door closing in front of a passenger with a dull pneumatic thud and a low disappointed tone

name: invalid-buzz
prompt: Short low error buzz from a ticket gate rejecting an invalid move, harsh electronic denial

name: move-denied
prompt: A gentle wooden double knock, like rapping on a counter to signal the action is not allowed

name: win-jingle
prompt: Bright upbeat station arrival jingle on glockenspiel with a small crowd applauding at the end

name: lose-descend
prompt: A short descending wah-wah of a muted trombone, comic disappointment after a failed round

name: lose-overfill
prompt: A crowded station platform murmur swelling then cut off by a soft low failure tone
